arguments.message: Hi there! When a card on file expires and your workspace is suspended, you can add a new payment method yourself by going to **Settings → Billing → Payment method**. After you save the new card, our billing team will retry the failed charge and lift the suspension. This isn’t instant – the team usually processes the retry and restores access within a short window once the new card is added. If you’ve already added the new card, just give it a little time and your access should be reinstated shortly.
